tasks.title: V5 schema and private immutable file storage
tasks.scope: Inspect V4 and existing models. Add compatible V5 Flyway migration, Review document metadata and expected time/decision fields, correction notification type, private storage service and focused migration/storage tests. Preserve fileless Sprint 3 rows and never modify V1–V4.

tasks.title: Translator file submission and legacy attachment
tasks.scope: Change existing submit API to multipart PDF/DOCX with transactional Activity lock and one Review cycle; add one-time file attachment for an existing open fileless Sprint 3 Review; add authorized original download and translator history API. Enforce responsible ownership, CSRF, safe file handling, no post-submit replacement and duplicate-submit safety. Add meaningful backend tests.

tasks.title: Chief Editor decisions and correction cycle
tasks.scope: Implement assigned-editor Review detail, expected checking hours, approve/request-correction decision, responsible-translator notification, correction re-upload and next Review cycle. Closed Review result, feedback, expected time and file stay immutable. Enforce editor ownership even after project reassignment; lock/unique constraints protect concurrent requests. Add service/controller/security tests.

tasks.title: Chief Editor assigned projects, queue and workload API
tasks.scope: Add role/ownership-scoped assigned projects, open Review queue and compact workload API: open count, known expected hours, missing-estimate count. Do not label backlog as current week without due dates. Use service/repository layers and focused pagination/query tests as needed.

tasks.title: Translator correction and document UI
tasks.scope: Integrate multipart submit, review history/download, correction feedback/notification and corrected-file re-upload in existing translator pages. Keep existing Sprint 3 flow and design tokens; no embedded editor or DOCX preview. Backend remains the authority for action permissions. Add focused UI tests.

tasks.title: Compact Chief Editor review UI
tasks.scope: Build assigned-project view, Review queue/detail, original download, expected-time field, text feedback and Approve/Request Correction controls, plus one simple workload summary. Show history and closed states read-only. Follow docs/DESIGN.md and semantic CSS variables; avoid extra dashboard components and all in-app document editing/preview. Add UI tests.

tasks.title: PostgreSQL, security and isolated E2E acceptance
tasks.scope: Add/execute meaningful PostgreSQL migration, concurrency, ownership, CSRF, file safety and cross-role E2E tests. Use isolated E2E database and bounded service startup; do not mutate developer data. Fix defects within Sprint 4 scope. Write exact commands and counts to docs/night-runner/sprint4-verification.md, including truthful standalone lines POSTGRESQL: PASS, SECURITY: PASS and E2E: PASS only after those checks actually pass. If a prerequisite is unavailable, explain it and leave the task blocked instead of claiming completion.

tasks.title: Final documentation and Sprint 4 status
tasks.scope: Review actual code and verification evidence. Update existing API, architecture, design, run and state docs as appropriate; create docs/SPRINT_4_STATUS.md with story-by-story outcome, schema/API/business rules, exact test results and limitations. Ensure plan vs implementation differences are explicit. Do not claim tests that did not run.
